headline: Gadgets, apps, and film photos this week
body: I've been working on Away, a train display, and Reach, my desk clock, which now has a public page with a little LED-style preview. Snippy is live on the Chrome Web Store, and the Apps page got a fresh look where a swarm of cursors builds it up. I'm still shooting film too, and the photo gallery now has a neat square grid.
items: Snippy is live on the Chrome Web Store
Away gained a travel mode and display screens
SweetTreat, formerly Food Budget, has its own page
Photography page has a square grid and film Instagram
